minutes.headline: Conservation Commission continued all four wetland hearings to May 4 for missing plans or delineations, and approved a pollinator habitat purchase.
minutes.summary: The commission heard notices and requests for determination for work near wetlands and the lake. Hearings at 160 and 205 Sunset Lane, 411 Goodrich Street, 92 Wilder Road and 192 Townsend Harbor Road were continued for updated plans, delineations or site visits. A pool at 8 Butterfly Lane received a negative determination with a condition, and a small purchase for the pollinator habitat was funded from the Hollis Road fund.

public_comment.topic: Call for public comment; none raised before the first hearing.
Mr. Luck raised concern about a trend of decks on small lots in the 30-foot no-touch zone around the lake and asked for the rationale for allowing them.
Carl Luck commented favourably on the 205 Sunset dock design and asked whether the commission would comment on decks in the 30-foot zone.
Dave commented that saltwater pool discharge is minimal and harmless to grass.
Applicant David (411 Goodrich) said he was frustrated by the timing and by learning of the delineation need only at the hearing.

what_happened.line: The commission voted to fund a pollinator habitat plant purchase from the Hollis Road fund; mirrors and other habitat costs were held back for firmer numbers.
Hearings for 160 and 205 Sunset Lane, 411 Goodrich Street and 192 Townsend Harbor Road were continued, most to May 4.
The 92 Wilder Road tree removal hearing was continued to a later date, not May 4.
An above-ground pool at 8 Butterfly Lane received a negative determination, on condition that all discharge be outside the 100-foot buffer.
The agent will meet the 411 Goodrich applicant on site to refine the wetland delineation before the next hearing.

why_it_matters: Four wetland projects near the lake and wetlands are still undecided, so work on those lots cannot proceed until the commission closes the hearings.
Residents raised decks in the 30-foot no-touch zone around the lake, and the minutes record no ruling on that question.
watch_next: The May 4 hearings for 205 Sunset Lane, 411 Goodrich Street and 192 Townsend Harbor Road, and the site visits on the first.
The firmer numbers for mirrors and other habitat costs that the commission asked to see.
